kit_page.name: weather_kit
kit_page.summary: Rain, snowfall and mixed physical rates, weather wind and optional visibility. Needs Advanced Lighting Model.

kit_row.help: Shows the active blockers for library weather and automatic lightning.
kit_row.label: Requires

kit_row.help: Reset every weather setting to its built-in default.
kit_row.label: Reset all

kit_row.help: Choose existing rain or the physical weather library. Existing rain preserves your saved tuning.
kit_row.label: Weather controls

kit_row.help: Use your local weather target. Off eases the library to clear; no parcel source in this release.
kit_row.label: Local weather

kit_row.help: Physical rain rate in mm/h. Zero stops rain; brightness remains a separate artistic control.
kit_row.label: Rain rate (mm/h)

kit_row.help: How strongly passing rain bands vary the rate. Zero holds the mean rate steady.
kit_row.label: Rain bands

kit_row.help: Choose simulator wind or the local weather wind controls.
kit_row.label: Wind source

kit_row.help: Wind comes FROM this bearing: north 0 degrees, east 90. Used with Weather wind.
kit_row.label: From (deg)

kit_row.help: Mean weather wind speed in metres per second. Used with Weather wind.
kit_row.label: Speed (m/s)

kit_row.help: Weather wind speed variation around its mean. Does not add the old procedural rain gust twice.
kit_row.label: Speed variation

kit_row.help: Weather wind changes from slow swells to sharper gusts. Used with nonzero speed variation.
kit_row.label: Gustiness

kit_row.help: Maximum weather wind direction swing in degrees.
kit_row.label: Swing (deg)

kit_row.help: Transition duration for preset or rate changes. Zero changes immediately.
kit_row.label: Transition (s)

kit_row.help: Deterministic seed for rain bands, gusts and weather storm strikes. Editing restarts the local pattern.
kit_row.label: Weather seed

kit_row.help: Weather storm lightning amount. Used only with Weather storm timing and Local weather.
kit_row.label: Storm amount

kit_row.help: Select exactly one lightning scheduler in Weather library mode. Existing timing uses Strikes/min; Weather storm uses Storm amount.
kit_row.label: Lightning timing

kit_row.help: Apply rain or snow rates. Blizzard also selects Weather wind at least 15 m/s. Presets leave ground snow, relief and visibility off unless already chosen separately.
kit_row.keywords: drizzle steady heavy downpour preset flurries steady snow heavy snow blizzard
kit_row.label: Weather preset

kit_row.help: Apply the selected rain or snow preset and select local Weather library mode. Turn on the Weather master first. Secondary effects, including Lightning, stay as chosen.
kit_row.label: Apply preset

kit_row.help: Transition rain and storm amount to zero. Existing rain stops its rain layer and automatic lightning.
kit_row.label: Stop precipitation

kit_row.help: Source, physical rate falling now, target, transition and actual wind speed.
kit_row.keywords: status source current rate transition wind
kit_row.label: Current weather

kit_row.help: Artistic rain brightness. Library mode scales this by the physical rate; it never changes the measured mm/h.
kit_row.label: Intensity

kit_row.help: How many raindrops fill the view. Higher is heavier rain.
kit_row.label: Density

kit_row.help: How fast the drops fall, in meters per second.
kit_row.label: Fall speed

kit_row.help: How far wind slants the rain. Scales the selected simulator or weather wind.
kit_row.label: Wind response

kit_row.help: Existing rain procedural gust strength. Weather library uses Weather wind gusts instead.
kit_row.label: Gust strength

kit_row.help: Existing rain sky/cloud coupling. Library physical rain rates are never multiplied by cloud cover.
kit_row.label: Cloud link

kit_row.help: Farthest camera distance at which rain is drawn. Lower is faster.
kit_row.label: Draw distance

kit_row.help: Depth samples per pixel for rain, from 4 to 24. Higher is smoother and slower.
kit_row.label: Ray samples

kit_row.help: Rain render size divisor: 1 is full, 2 is half, up to 4 for speed.
kit_row.label: Resolution

kit_row.help: How many near, middle and far rain layers are drawn, from 1 to 3.
kit_row.label: Depth layers

kit_row.help: Virtual exposure time in seconds. It sets streak length from the fall speed.
kit_row.label: Shutter

kit_row.help: Adds size and energy to raindrops close to the camera.
kit_row.label: Near emphasis

kit_row.help: Rain streak colour; leaves physical rainfall unchanged.
kit_row.label: Rain colour

kit_row.help: How often a splash appears on each up-facing surface.
kit_row.label: Density

kit_row.help: Largest radius of a splash ring, in meters.
kit_row.label: Ring radius

kit_row.help: Farthest camera distance at which splashes are drawn.
kit_row.label: Impact range

kit_row.help: How long each splash stays visible, in seconds.
kit_row.label: Lifetime

kit_row.help: How level a surface must be to get splashes and wetness. Higher is stricter.
kit_row.label: Up threshold

kit_row.help: Adds a glossy wet look to up-facing surfaces during rain.
kit_row.label: Wet sheen

kit_row.help: How strong the wet sheen looks on surfaces.
kit_row.label: Wetness

kit_row.help: Adds a faint layer of rain mist near the ground. Off by default.
kit_row.label: Ground mist

kit_row.help: How visible the ground mist is.
kit_row.label: Mist strength

kit_row.help: Height in meters of the ground mist around the terrain anchor.
kit_row.label: Mist height

kit_row.help: Adds rain drops on the camera lens for a point-of-view shot. Off by default.
kit_row.label: Lens drops

kit_row.help: How strong and dense the lens raindrops are.
kit_row.label: Lens strength

kit_row.help: How far the rain-cover map reaches around the camera, in meters. Keep it past the rain distance.
kit_row.keywords: cover map radius extent occlusion roof
kit_row.label: Map radius

kit_row.help: Depth tolerance in meters when testing whether a roof covers a point.
kit_row.label: Vertical bias

kit_row.help: Width in meters of the fade between sheltered and exposed rain.
kit_row.label: Softness

kit_row.help: Fade rain beneath visible roofs when spatial shelter is off. Also controls lens drops when spatial shelter is on.
kit_row.keywords: rain shelter fallback ray lens visible roof cover altitude
kit_row.label: Rain shelter

kit_row.help: Resolution of the rain-cover depth map per side. Higher is sharper and costs more.
kit_row.label: Map detail

kit_row.help: How far up, in meters, the fallback ray looks for cover.
kit_row.label: Cover height

kit_row.help: Average number of automatic lightning strikes per minute.
kit_row.label: Strikes/min

kit_row.help: How bright the bolt and the scene flash are.
kit_row.label: Brightness

kit_row.help: How long the scene flash lasts, in seconds.
kit_row.label: Flash length

kit_row.help: Fires one lightning strike immediately.
kit_row.label: Strike now

kit_row.help: How long the procedural bolt stays visible, in seconds.
kit_row.label: Bolt time

kit_row.help: Lowest overall flash light, mixed with the directional lighting.
kit_row.label: Ambient floor

kit_row.help: Width of the bolt's bright core, in pixels.
kit_row.label: Bolt width

kit_row.help: Height of the bolt above the terrain, in meters.
kit_row.label: Bolt height

kit_row.help: Closest a strike can land from the avatar, in meters.
kit_row.label: Minimum range

kit_row.help: Farthest a strike can land from the avatar, in meters.
kit_row.label: Maximum range

kit_row.help: Colour of the existing and weather-timed lightning presentation.
kit_row.label: Lightning colour

kit_row.help: Bolt geometry tier: 1 high, 2 very high, 3 machinima.
kit_row.label: Quality tier

kit_row.help: Lights the cloud layer during a strike, shaped by the sky's clouds. Off by default.
kit_row.label: Cloud sheet

kit_row.help: How strong the cloud sheet glow is.
kit_row.label: Sheet strength

kit_row.help: Wide colored halo around the bolt, which feeds bloom.
kit_row.label: Corona

kit_row.help: Lingering cloud and scene glow after a strike.
kit_row.label: Afterglow

kit_row.help: Blends from even strikes to bolt-close and distant cinematic grading.
kit_row.label: Distance grade

kit_row.help: Adds a lightning sparkle on rain-wet surfaces. Off by default.
kit_row.label: Wet glint

kit_row.help: Strength of the lightning sparkle on wet surfaces.
kit_row.label: Glint strength

kit_row.help: Upper limit on how bright the lightning addition can get, in linear HDR.
kit_row.label: HDR peak cap

kit_row.help: Persistent outdoor wet materials in either rain mode. Requires Advanced Lighting Model and complete basic cover; replaces Wet sheen while active. Avatars are excluded.
kit_row.keywords: wet puddle surface cover soak dry ripple persistent wet surfaces
kit_row.label: Persistent wet surfaces

kit_row.help: Reflective patches on level exposed surfaces. Requires Persistent wet surfaces; follows current reflection settings.
kit_row.keywords: wet puddle surface cover soak dry ripple puddles
kit_row.label: Puddles

kit_row.help: Linear dielectric darkening and water film amount. Requires Persistent wet surfaces.
kit_row.keywords: wet puddle surface cover soak dry ripple wet amount
kit_row.label: Wet amount

kit_row.help: Area of world-anchored puddles on level surfaces. Requires Puddles and Persistent wet surfaces.
kit_row.keywords: wet puddle surface cover soak dry ripple puddle amount
kit_row.label: Puddle amount

kit_row.help: Filtered rain ripple normal strength. Requires wet puddles and falling rain.
kit_row.keywords: wet puddle surface cover soak dry ripple ripple strength
kit_row.label: Ripple strength

kit_row.help: Seconds to soak in moderate rain at 5 mm/h. Heavy rain soaks faster.
kit_row.keywords: wet puddle surface cover soak dry ripple soak time (s)
kit_row.label: Soak time (s)

kit_row.help: Seconds to dry after rain stops. Stop precipitation leaves surfaces drying.
kit_row.keywords: wet puddle surface cover soak dry ripple dry time (s)
kit_row.label: Dry time (s)

kit_row.help: Wetness applied by Apply starting surfaces and at a successful teleport.
kit_row.keywords: wet puddle surface cover soak dry ripple starting wetness
kit_row.label: Starting wetness

kit_row.help: Basic cover map pixels per side. Powers of two; higher detail increases memory and render cost.
kit_row.keywords: wet puddle surface cover soak dry ripple surface cover detail
kit_row.label: Surface cover detail

kit_row.help: Basic cover half extent in metres around the recording camera. Outside coverage stays dry; remote cameras need coverage.
kit_row.keywords: wet puddle surface cover soak dry ripple coverage (m)
kit_row.label: Coverage (m)

kit_row.help: Set accumulated water to Starting wetness without changing the storm.
kit_row.label: Starting surfaces

kit_row.help: Clear accumulated water immediately without stopping precipitation.
kit_row.label: Clear surfaces

kit_row.help: Basic cover publication and coverage. Unknown coverage suppresses wet response.
kit_row.keywords: surface cover validity failed incomplete open sky
kit_row.label: Surface coverage

kit_row.help: Falling flakes. Turning on selects Local weather, Weather library and Snow if the type was Rain. Requires Advanced Lighting Model and OpenGL 4.5 with texture barriers. Ground accumulation is separate.
kit_row.keywords: snow snowfall flakes mixed visibility veil falling snow
kit_row.label: Falling snow

kit_row.help: Select Rain, Snow or Mixed and activate Local Weather library mode. Snow and Mixed also enable Falling snow. Requires Advanced Lighting Model and OpenGL 4.5 with texture barriers.
kit_row.keywords: snow snowfall flakes mixed visibility veil precipitation
kit_row.label: Precipitation

kit_row.help: Fresh snowfall in cm/h, 0 to 360. Zero stops snowfall; no ground snow is enabled. Requires Advanced Lighting Model and OpenGL 4.5 with texture barriers.
kit_row.keywords: snow snowfall flakes mixed visibility veil snowfall (cm/h)
kit_row.label: Snowfall rate (cm/h)

kit_row.help: Flake diameter in metres, 0.002 to 0.08. Distant flakes preserve subpixel coverage. Requires Advanced Lighting Model and OpenGL 4.5 with texture barriers.
kit_row.keywords: snow snowfall flakes mixed visibility veil flake size (m)
kit_row.label: Flake size (m)

kit_row.help: Downward snowfall speed in m/s, 0.2 to 4, on the shared weather clock. Requires Advanced Lighting Model and OpenGL 4.5 with texture barriers.
kit_row.keywords: snow snowfall flakes mixed visibility veil fall speed (m/s)
kit_row.label: Fall speed (m/s)

kit_row.help: Snow volume radius in metres, 16 to 128. Each recording camera sees its own world cells. Requires Advanced Lighting Model and OpenGL 4.5 with texture barriers.
kit_row.keywords: snow snowfall flakes mixed visibility veil draw distance (m)
kit_row.label: Draw distance (m)

kit_row.help: Maximum GPU flakes per view, 4096 to 131072. Default 32768; higher caps have a separate cost. Requires Advanced Lighting Model and OpenGL 4.5 with texture barriers.
kit_row.keywords: snow snowfall flakes mixed visibility veil flake limit
kit_row.label: Flake limit

kit_row.help: Optional physical precipitation veil, applied once to open-sky depth. Replaces existing mist while active; presets never enable it. Requires Advanced Lighting Model and OpenGL 4.5 with texture barriers.
kit_row.keywords: snow snowfall flakes mixed visibility veil precipitation visibility
kit_row.label: Precipitation visibility

kit_row.help: Physical extinction multiplier, 0 to 1. Requires Precipitation visibility and valid world cover. Requires Advanced Lighting Model and OpenGL 4.5 with texture barriers.
kit_row.keywords: snow snowfall flakes mixed visibility veil visibility amount
kit_row.label: Visibility amount

kit_row.help: GPU support, shader/resource failure and world cover for the recording view. No CPU particle fallback.
kit_row.keywords: snow gpu compute unavailable support cover memory status
kit_row.label: Snow availability

kit_row.help: Use dedicated near/far maps for rain, wet surfaces, snow and precipitation visibility. Off preserves the existing shelter choice. Blended glass does not stop precipitation.
kit_row.keywords: shelter roof doorway cover wind update coverage advanced shelter
kit_row.label: Advanced shelter

kit_row.help: Near map pixels (power of two). The two read/write map pairs must fit 16 MiB; reduce detail if status reports unknown coverage.
kit_row.keywords: shelter roof doorway cover wind update coverage near detail
kit_row.label: Near detail

kit_row.help: Far map pixels (power of two). More detail uses more memory and geometry work.
kit_row.keywords: shelter roof doorway cover wind update coverage far detail
kit_row.label: Far detail

kit_row.help: Half-width in metres of the detailed shelter area, snapped to world cells.
kit_row.keywords: shelter roof doorway cover wind update coverage near coverage
kit_row.label: Near coverage

kit_row.help: Half-width in metres of the distant shelter area. Remote VCam and Prism views outside coverage remain unknown; prepare the area from the main camera.
kit_row.keywords: shelter roof doorway cover wind update coverage far coverage
kit_row.label: Far coverage

kit_row.help: Follow the slow mean weather wind with a bounded fall angle. Individual gusts never recenter the maps.
kit_row.keywords: shelter roof doorway cover wind update coverage follow weather wind
kit_row.label: Follow weather wind

kit_row.help: Maximum dirty geometry and wind refreshes per second. Static geometry reuses its published maps.
kit_row.keywords: shelter roof doorway cover wind update coverage update rate
kit_row.label: Update rate

kit_row.help: Depth comparison tolerance in metres. Too much bias leaks beneath thin roofs.
kit_row.keywords: shelter roof doorway cover wind update coverage bias
kit_row.label: Bias

kit_row.help: Depth comparison fade in metres near roof edges.
kit_row.keywords: shelter roof doorway cover wind update coverage softness
kit_row.label: Softness

kit_row.help: Colour the rain pass by close/distant coverage, cover and missing data in main and auxiliary views.
kit_row.keywords: shelter roof doorway cover wind update coverage show shelter
kit_row.label: Show shelter

kit_row.help: Reports map update rate, coverage, failures and transparent cover limitations.
kit_row.keywords: shelter update coverage status unknown failed glass roof
kit_row.label: Update / coverage status
